benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: IndusInd Bank Crest Credit Card is a premium, invite-only card issued by the bank to high-income consumers who are looking for luxury, convenience, and rewards across travel, lifestyle, and entertainment benefits. The consumer can avail of 8 complimentary domestic and international airport lounge benefits, along with a free LoungeKey membership. IndusInd Crest Credit Card offers 2.5 points per Rs. 100 spent on international spends and 1 point per Rs 100 spent on domestic spends. This card also offers 3 golf rounds and lessons per month with VIP access to premium courses through the TPC Network. Additionally, this card offers decent value on movie tickets, and cardholders can get 20% off on BookMyShow event and theatre booking, buy-1-get-1-free movie tickets up to 3 per month. Additional benefits include dining discounts at select restaurants and ITC hotels, fuel surcharge waiver, personal accident insurance up to Rs. 25 lakh, and 24/7 Crest Concierge & Auto Assist services, making it a complete lifestyle and travel credit card. IndusInd Crest Credit Card is a suitable option for consumers who want to opt for a credit card that combines luxury, convenience and rewards such as domestic and international airport lounge access, golf benefits, premium dining benefits and reward points.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the IndusInd Crest Credit Card?
faqs.a: This is an invite-only credit card. Eligibility is determined by IndusInd Bank based on internal criteria such as income profile, relationship value, and creditworthiness.

faqs.q: What are the lounge access benefits offered?
faqs.a: Cardholders can avail 2 complimentary international and 2 domestic airport lounge visits per quarter on a min. spend of Rs. 5 Lakh in the previous quarter, totaling up to 8 annual visits, along with a complimentary LoungeKey membership.

faqs.q: How does the reward points system work?
faqs.a: Cosnumers can earn 2.5 reward points per Rs. 100 on international spends and 1 point per Rs. 100 on domestic spends, redeemable at approximately Rs. 0.75 per point.

faqs.q: What golf benefits are included with the card?
faqs.a: The card offers 3 complimentary golf rounds and 3 lessons per month, amounting to 36 rounds annually, with access to select premium golf courses through partner networks.

faqs.q: What are the fees and annual charges?
faqs.a: The joining fee is Rs. 75,000 plus taxes, and the annual fee is Rs. 10,000 plus taxes, which may be waived on annual spending of Rs. 10 lakh.

faqs.q: Are there any movie or entertainment benefits?
faqs.a: Cardholders can avail 20% discount on BookMyShow bookings and buy-one-get-one-free movie tickets, capped at Rs. 700 per ticket, up to 3 times per month.

faqs.q: Does the card offer dining-related benefits?
faqs.a: Consumers can avail discounts at select partner restaurants and ITC hotels, including up to 25% off on food and beverages and additional offers under Club ITC programs.

practical_community_warnings: Verify quarterly spend threshold before relying on complimentary lounge entry.
High 3.5% (+GST) forex markup makes international swipes net negative.
optimization_tips: Avoid foreign currency & international SaaS charges on this card due to 3.5% + GST forex markup; use a 0%-forex card instead.
Track ₹1,000,000 annual retail spend before anniversary month to waive renewal fees — rent/govt/wallet spends often don't count.
Check spend criteria and pre-generate terminal QR access via official portals (LoungeOne.ai / TFS / HOI) before arriving at the airport.
